8.3.4 DoIP_IfTransmit
[SWS_DoIP_00277] Definition of API function DoIP_IfTransmit
Upstream requirements: RS_Diag_00024
⌈
Service Name
DoIP_IfTransmit
Syntax
Std_ReturnType DoIP_IfTransmit (
PduIdType TxPduId,
const PduInfoType* PduInfoPtr
)
Service ID [hex]
0x49
Sync/Async
Synchronous
Reentrancy
Reentrant for different PduIds. Non reentrant for the same PduId.
TxPduId
Identifier of the PDU to be transmitted
Parameters (in)
PduInfoPtr
Length of and pointer to the PDU data and pointer to MetaData.
Parameters (inout)
None
Parameters (out)
None
Return value
Std_ReturnType
E_OK: Transmit request has been accepted.
E_NOT_OK: Transmit request has not been accepted.
Description
Requests transmission of a PDU.
Available via
DoIP.h
⌋
